
library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# ✅ Load dataset with correct encoding
# ✅ Load dataset with correct encoding (handles special characters)
road_safety <- read_csv("D:/INT 553(Data Cleaning)/12401502_Ayush_15/road_safety.csv", locale = locale(encoding = "Latin1"))

# ✅ Convert all character columns to UTF-8
road_safety <- road_safety %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ iconv(.x, from = "latin1", to = "UTF-8", sub = " ")))

# UI
ui <- dashboardPage(
  dashboardHeader(title = "Road Safety Dashboard"),
  dashboardSidebar(
    selectInput("severity", "Select Casualty Severity:",
                choices = unique(road_safety$`Casualty Severity`),
                selected = "Slight"),
    selectInput("gender", "Select Sex of Casualty:",
                choices = unique(road_safety$`Sex of Casualty`),
                selected = "Male")
  ),
  dashboardBody(
    fluidRow(
      box(title = "Accidents by Road Class", width = 6, status = "primary", solidHeader = TRUE,
          plotOutput("plot_road_class")),
      box(title = "Accidents by Weather Condition", width = 6, status = "warning", solidHeader = TRUE,
          plotOutput("plot_weather"))
    ),
    fluidRow(
      box(title = "Accidents by Lighting Conditions", width = 6, status = "info", solidHeader = TRUE,
          plotOutput("plot_lighting")),
      box(title = "Accidents by Vehicle Type", width = 6, status = "success", solidHeader = TRUE,
          plotOutput("plot_vehicle"))
    )
  )
)

# Server
server <- function(input, output) {
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    road_safety %>%
      filter(`Casualty Severity` == input$severity,
             `Sex of Casualty` == input$gender)
  })
  
  output$plot_road_class <- renderPlot({
    ggplot(filtered_data(), aes(x = `1st Road Class`)) +
      geom_bar(fill = "#0073C2FF") +
      labs(title = paste("Road Class -", input$severity, "-", input$gender),
           x = "Road Class", y = "Count") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  })
  
  output$plot_weather <- renderPlot({
    ggplot(filtered_data(), aes(x = `Weather Conditions`)) +
      geom_bar(fill = "#D55E00") +
      labs(title = paste("Weather Conditions -", input$severity, "-", input$gender),
           x = "Weather", y = "Count") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  })
  
  output$plot_lighting <- renderPlot({
    ggplot(filtered_data(), aes(x = `Lighting Conditions`)) +
      geom_bar(fill = "#33A02C") +
      labs(title = paste("Lighting -", input$severity, "-", input$gender),
           x = "Lighting Conditions", y = "Count") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  })
  
  output$plot_vehicle <- renderPlot({
    ggplot(filtered_data(), aes(x = `Type of Vehicle`)) +
      geom_bar(fill = "#6A3D9A") +
      labs(title = paste("Vehicle Type -", input$severity, "-", input$gender),
           x = "Vehicle Type", y = "Count") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  })
}

# Run App
shinyApp(ui, server)
